speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Ten days short of a month. That is the age of the lovers. Tonight I walk out between the degrees, and I am not going to explain the room to the room.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Nick. Under every note. Grave, and low. A whisper in that hall is a speech. Thou wilt not give them an extra one because thou art pleased.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He holds to the dagger. He does not come up onto the note to show he can. The order is the one thou gavest him, Augustine, and a palace has not cancelled it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I will not look away. Not once. If the voice moves I am with him. I am not giving the chair my eyes instead of the boy.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The Nurse will do what my lord said a nurse would do. I have his sentence. I am not going to rehearse it over a breakfast, where a pot-boy can carry it downstairs.

speaker: john_heminges
text: And nothing from last night goes into a book this morning. A likeness is not a receipt. Tonight is a second night. I count men at the door. There is no yard to count.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Do I bow at nine, or at about ten?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou bowest when George bows. Those two hours stood yesterday, and I am not picking a winner over bread. Tonight the hall is already night. Indoors, every hour is night. The vault will not make thee a dusk.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Happiness is not a licence to sing the note. If he is glad he will want it. He may not have it. Tonight is not a jig.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Say the prologue as it is written, Will. Do not help it. A chorus who explains a palace is a man talking himself into being seen.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One line at the head of the part is enough to carry. I am not copying the rest out for comfort. Ten days short of a month is a count I can do on my hands, with a day left over.

speaker: john_heminges
text: We are looked for after eight, at their door, not before. Baskets stay where they are. Nobody makes a story of last night's hand at this table.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I will not play her as a speech about nurses. She does the thing. The hall hears it or it does not. That is the whole of my bravery.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Yesterday I bowed at a canopy. Tonight I am where Augustine puts me. If a thing falls I will know, because the floor will have people on it.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Thou art not a fairy tonight, Sam. Yesterday's feet stay in yesterday's room. Thy work is the place I give thee.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we are set. Under the note. Richard has said he will not look away, and I believe him. God keep you.

speaker: john_heminges
text: And you. I will see the heads at the door, and I will not see a sum.
